en.name: Chilli oil
en.summary: Two jars of chilli oil can look identical and be completely different foods. Oil made with dried chilli and dried spices is low-risk and keeps in the cupboard, about 1–3 months after opening before it goes stale. Oil holding fresh garlic, ginger, chilli or herbs is low-acid produce under oil: refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or lower and use within no more than 4 days, or freeze it for about 3 months.
en.pantry: This is the one condiment where the difference between two similar-looking jars is a safety difference, so there is no single pantry number. Chilli oil made by pouring hot oil over dried chilli flakes and dried spices, then strained or left with only dried solids, is low-risk and is what commercial jars are. Chilli oil holding fresh garlic, fresh ginger, fresh chilli, shallot or fresh herbs is low-acid produce sealed under oil in an oxygen-free environment — the classic setting for Clostridium botulinum. Spores on herbs, garlic or tomatoes placed in oil can produce toxin in that anaerobic mixture, and using dried rather than fresh aromatics reduces the risk. Never leave an oil holding fresh produce at room temperature. For a dried-aromatic or commercial bottle, an opened one runs about 1–3 months before the oil turns stale — the same figure given for opened salad oils. Keep it capped, dark and away from the cooker.
en.fridge: The fridge is mandatory for any chilli oil containing fresh garlic, ginger, chilli, shallot or herbs. The rule for garlic in oil is the rule here: make it fresh, store it at 4 °C (40 °F) or lower, and use it within no more than 4 days. Refrigerating a dried-aromatic or commercial chilli oil is optional and extends it, at the cost of the oil clouding and thickening until it comes back to room temperature.
en.freezer: Freezing is the safe way to keep a fresh-aromatic chilli oil for longer: garlic in oil may be frozen for long-term storage for up to several months, and about 3 months is a sensible limit. Freeze it in a small jar with a little headspace, or in an ice-cube tray, at −18 °C (0 °F), then transfer the cubes to a bag. A commercial dried-aromatic oil does not need freezing at all.
en.thawing: Thaw a frozen fresh-aromatic chilli oil in the fridge and use it within a few days, or drop a frozen cube straight into a hot pan. Never thaw it at room temperature — that returns it to exactly the conditions you froze it to avoid.
spoilage: A rancid, crayon-like or paint-like smell from the oil
Cloudiness, bubbles or gas in a jar that has been sitting
Mould on solids standing above the oil
A jar that fizzes or spurts when opened — discard it unopened if the lid has bulged
tips: Use dried aromatics if you want a chilli oil that lives in the cupboard.
Label a fresh-aromatic batch with the date you made it — the window is short.
Botulinum toxin cannot be seen, smelled or tasted, so an oil with fresh produce in it can never be judged by inspection.
Freeze small cubes of homemade oil rather than keeping a big jar you cannot finish in days.

faq.q: Does chilli oil need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: It depends on what is in it. Dried-chilli and commercial oils keep in the cupboard, about 1–3 months once opened. Anything with fresh garlic, ginger, chilli or herbs must be refrigerated and used within no more than 4 days.

faq.q: Can you freeze homemade chilli oil?
faq.a: Yes, and for a fresh-aromatic oil it is the right answer. Freeze it in a jar with headspace or as cubes at −18 °C for about 3 months.

faq.q: Is homemade garlic chilli oil dangerous?
faq.a: It can be if left at room temperature. Low-acid produce under oil is an oxygen-free environment where Clostridium botulinum can produce toxin. Keep it cold, use it within days, or freeze it.

faq.q: How can you tell if chilli oil has gone off?
faq.a: Rancidity you can smell — crayon or old paint. Botulism you cannot: it has no smell, taste or appearance, which is why the storage rule is the only protection.

zh.name: 辣椒油
zh.summary: 兩罐看起來一模一樣的辣油，可能是完全不同的食物。用乾辣椒和乾香料潑製的辣油風險低，可以放櫥櫃，開封後大約 1～3 個月會開始走味。含新鮮蒜、薑、辣椒或香草的辣油，則是低酸性食材泡在油裡：必須放 4 °C 以下冷藏、最多 4 天內用完，或冷凍大約 3 個月。
zh.pantry: 這是少數「兩罐看起來很像，但差別在安全」的調味料，所以這裡沒有單一的常溫天數。把熱油澆在乾辣椒片和乾香料上，之後濾掉或只留乾料的辣油，風險低，市售罐裝就是這一種。含新鮮蒜末、薑、辣椒、油蔥或新鮮香草的辣油，則是低酸性食材被密封在無氧的油下——那正是肉毒桿菌最典型的環境。附著在香草、蒜頭或番茄上的孢子，在這種無氧的調味油中可以產生毒素，而改用乾燥辛香料就能降低風險。含新鮮食材的油，絕對不要放在室溫。乾料款或市售款開封後大約 1～3 個月油會開始走味，這和開封後沙拉油的數字相同。請蓋緊、避光、遠離爐火。
zh.fridge: 只要辣油裡含有新鮮蒜、薑、辣椒、油蔥或香草，冷藏就是必須的。蒜頭泡油的規則就是這裡的規則：現做、放 4 °C 以下保存、最多 4 天內用完。乾料款或市售辣油要不要冷藏是選擇題，冷藏能延長風味，代價是油會變濁變稠，要回到室溫才恢復。
zh.freezer: 冷凍是讓含新鮮辛香料的辣油放久一點的安全做法：蒜頭泡油可以冷凍保存數個月，這裡以大約 3 個月為合理上限。裝小罐留一點膨脹空間，或用製冰盒凍成小塊後裝袋，放 −18 °C。市售乾料辣油則完全不需要冷凍。
zh.thawing: 含新鮮辛香料的冷凍辣油請放冷藏解凍，並在幾天內用完，或直接挖一塊丟進熱鍋。絕對不要放室溫解凍——那等於把它送回你當初冷凍要避開的環境。
spoilage: 油聞起來有油耗味、蠟筆味或油漆味
放了一陣子的罐子出現混濁、氣泡或氣體
露出油面的固體料長霉
開罐時冒氣或噴出——蓋子已經鼓起的請不要開，直接丟掉
tips: 想要一罐能放櫥櫃的辣油，就用乾燥辛香料。
含新鮮食材的自製辣油請標上製作日期——時間窗很短。
肉毒桿菌毒素看不到、聞不到、嚐不出來，所以含新鮮食材的油永遠無法用檢視來判斷。
自製的請凍成小塊，不要留一大罐幾天內吃不完的。

faq.a: 看裡面有什麼。乾辣椒款和市售款放櫥櫃即可，開封後大約 1～3 個月。含新鮮蒜、薑、辣椒或香草的則必須冷藏，最多 4 天內用完。

faq.q: 自製辣椒油可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，而且含新鮮辛香料的就該這樣做。裝罐留膨脹空間或凍成小塊，放 −18 °C 大約 3 個月。

faq.q: 自製蒜香辣油有危險嗎？
faq.a: 放室溫就可能有。低酸性食材泡在油裡是無氧環境，肉毒桿菌可以在其中產生毒素。請保持低溫、幾天內用完，或冷凍。
油耗可以聞出來——像蠟筆或舊油漆味。但肉毒桿菌不行：沒有味道、沒有氣味、看不出來，所以保存規則是唯一的防線。
